answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 57514 Country: India Title: saving bank interst Question: I have got some interest money from my saving bank accounts. Can I credit it for some bank deduction (1) Quarterly SMS charges, (2) Annual ATM charges and (3) Inter-branch charges? Answer ID: 57514 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 164/164/SD=04/1436) The ruling pertaining to interest money is that it should be given in charity to the poor and needy ones without the intention of reward. It is not lawful to derive personal benefit from it. Hence it is not lawful to use the interest money to meet the quarterly SMS charges, annual ATM charges or inter-branch charges. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
